user.title: Live Track Ships
user.description: Vessels near a point, from live AIS data. Not for navigation.

data_description.source: aisstream.io covers the whole world and needs a free API key. Fintraffic Digitraffic needs no key but only covers Finnish and Baltic waters. BarentsWatch covers Norwegian waters and gives the best data of the three — names and vessel types arrive with every position — but needs a free client registration.
data_description.api_key: Required for aisstream.io. Get one free at https://aisstream.io/account — it is shown once, so copy it before closing the page.
data_description.radius_km: Between {radius_min} and {radius_max} km. How many vessels this contains depends far more on which water than on how large — a 50 km circle held about 4 vessels over Chicago and about 340 over the Solent.
data_description.max_vessels: A safety limit, not a display setting. The map handles large numbers; this protects Home Assistant from a very large radius over very busy water.
data_description.client_id: BarentsWatch only. Register a free AIS-client at barentswatch.no/minside — the ID looks like your.email@example.com:live_track_ships. Enter it exactly as shown.
data_description.client_secret: BarentsWatch only. Shown once when the client is created; generate a new one if you did not keep it.

coverage.title: Part of this area has no coverage
coverage.description: About {percent}% of this circle lies outside the area BarentsWatch publishes, which is Norwegian waters. Vessels there will never appear, however busy the water is. Submit to use this circle anyway, or close this dialog and choose a smaller radius or another source.

error.radius_out_of_range: Radius must be between 1 and 500 km.
error.key_required: aisstream.io needs an API key. Get one free at https://aisstream.io/account, or choose Digitraffic instead.
error.invalid_location: That latitude or longitude is not valid.
error.client_id_required: BarentsWatch needs a client ID. Register a free AIS-client at barentswatch.no/minside.
error.client_secret_required: BarentsWatch needs a client secret. It is shown once when the client is created; generate a new one if you did not keep it.

abort.already_configured: This source is already tracking that location.

data.instance_max_vessels: Maximum vessels on the map, all Live Track Ships entries together

data_description.instance_max_vessels: Lower this on a small machine. It counts every Live Track Ships entry, whatever its source. With more than one entry, the lowest setting applies.

coverage.title: Part of this area has no coverage
coverage.description: About {percent}% of this circle lies outside the area BarentsWatch publishes, which is Norwegian waters. Vessels there will never appear, however busy the water is. Submit to save this radius anyway, or close this dialog to keep the current one.

map_card_duplicate_resources.title: The Live Track map card is registered more than once
map_card_duplicate_resources.description: These dashboard resources also load the map card: {urls}. Only one is used and the others do nothing. Remove them in Settings > Dashboards > Resources.
